sections.intro: PRO400DS overview: motorized, digitally controlled benchtop homogenization for larger vessels and precise speed control.
paragraphs: PRO400DS pairs a 1305W motor with digital speed control, the most power in the ProScientific range so far, aimed at labs that need real throughput without sacrificing precision. The PRO TRAC stand, a motorized stand developed specifically to handle motor positioning, moves the unit into place effortlessly, accurately, and smoothly rather than requiring manual adjustment for every sample.

Speed control gets genuinely finer here too. A 3-turn speed knob adjusts RPM in hundreds rather than thousands, and a bright LED display paired with a dual-power light indicator makes both setting the speed and spotting a problem straightforward.

Volume range runs from 0.05mL to 30L, covering everything from microliter-scale work to large vessel processing on the same unit, homogenizing, emulsifying, blending, and mixing both organic and inorganic materials. The entire ProScientific probe line mounts to this unit, though the probe itself isn't included and needs to be selected and ordered separately.

Speed control gets the same precision treatment. body: PRO400DS volume and probe: 0.05mL-30L range, separate probe selection, and stand length options.

Volume range on PRO400DS runs wide, 0.05mL up to 30L, but the actual maximum for a given sample depends on viscosity as much as the unit's rated capacity. Viscous samples reduce max capacity directly, and adding a Deflector Head to your generator probe helps by facilitating sample movement during homogenization, increasing the effective maximum volume you can process.

Since the probe isn't included, matching it to your vessel and sample type is a real configuration step, not an afterthought. And if your container needs more vertical clearance than the standard 14.5 inches provides, PRO400DSEL runs the same core unit with an Extra Length stand instead.

paragraphs: Some samples simply don't fit under a standard stand, and PRO400DSEL exists specifically for that situation.

Where the standard PRO400DS offers 14.5 inches of total length, PRO400DSEL's Extra Length stand more than doubles that to 31 inches, purpose-built for taller containers and unique glassware like large-scale carboys. The stand itself stays motorized, so that added height doesn't come with added physical effort, positioning remains effortless, smooth, and accurate whether you're working at the top or bottom of that extended range. For labs whose vessel sizes vary, that extra clearance means one unit can cover both standard and larger-format processing without switching equipment.

sections.tabSummary: Speed knob tuning, diagnostics, and containment
body: How PRO400DSEL's speed knob, diagnostics, and containment options keep processing reliable.
Homogenization results depend on hitting a consistent RPM run after run, and staying alert to problems before they affect your sample or damage the motor.

The 3-turn speed knob adjusts RPM in increments of hundreds, rather than the coarser thousands-based adjustment found on simpler units, giving the finer control that sensitive emulsions specifically need. A bright LED display keeps that setting visible clearly throughout a run. The Dual-Power Light Indicator adds a layer of diagnostic feedback, flagging errors or problems immediately so downtime and motor overload risk both stay lower. Where aerosol containment matters, the PRO SAFETY SEAL chamber assembly fits directly onto the unit to keep aerosols contained and cross-contamination risk down.
